anchors.description: Segment customers (all of their lines together).

attributes.description: Model output between 0 (loyal) and 1 (about to leave).

networks.description: Who calls whom (last 3 months, aggregated). Neighbours are other subscriptions.

templates.name: High-value postpaid at churn risk
templates.description: Postpaid lines with ARPU ≥ 200 SAR and a churn score of 0.6 or more.

templates.name: Churn contagion (social circle)
templates.description: Active lines where at least two frequent call contacts have already churned. A graph-native signal that attribute-only models miss.

templates.name: Social influencers
templates.description: Active lines with 20+ distinct call contacts, which makes them good seeds for referral campaigns.

templates.name: 5G upsell ready
templates.description: Heavy data users on a 5G device who are not yet on an unlimited plan.

templates.name: Prepaid → postpaid migration
templates.description: Prepaid lines with high recharge revenue and data usage, plus a good credit class.

templates.name: Travelers without a roaming bundle
templates.description: Lines that used roaming data in the last 6 months but have no roaming add-on.

templates.name: Expat international callers without a bundle
templates.description: Expat customers with 150+ international minutes over 3 months and no international add-on.

templates.name: Device upgrade candidates
templates.description: Gold and Platinum customers still using a device released in 2020 or earlier.

templates.name: Network detractors
templates.description: Customers who raised 2+ network tickets in the last 90 days, or who gave a low NPS score.

templates.name: Youth digital natives
templates.description: Customers aged 18–25 who use the self-care app.

templates.name: Multi-line households
templates.description: Customers with three or more active lines, a natural target for family and FMC bundles.
